job.job_description:
Hiring for Generative AI Engineer - Hyderabad About the Role: We are seeking a highly skilled Generative AI / ML Engineer with strong expertise in Python to join our AI/ML team. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying advanced machine learning models with a focus on generative models such as GPT, Diffusion Models, VAEs, and GANs.
Youll work on cutting-edge projects that involve text, image, or audio generation, and contribute to building intelligent systems for real-world applications.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, train, fine-tune, and evaluate generative AI models (e.g., GPT, BERT, DALL E, Stable Diffusion, GANs).
Implement ML pipelines using Python and frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Integrate generative models into production systems and APIs.
Collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and engineers to define and deliver AI-based features.
Conduct experiments, perform ablation studies, and optimize models for performance and scalability.
Stay updated with the latest research in generative AI, LLMs, and related ML technologies.
Write clean, modular, and well-documented code following software engineering best practices.
